variable_parameters.name: target_speed_mps
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: 3, 5 and 7 m/s engineering targets; no legal speed boundary

variable_parameters.name: protected_interest
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: stationary pedestrian life/limb or that person’s owned property
